results.quote: The stem run is six segments, 1 at the root collar, 6 at the crown.
Sap is counted in whole units, and every segment opens QUIET. (non-negativity not stated)
Holding volume: 10 8 12 6 9 7
Upper mark: 7 6 9 5 7 5
Lower mark: 3 2 4 2 3 2
every segment opens QUIET. ... Sap at start: 3 6 6 2 2 1
Leaf-drop threshold, whole stem: 38 ... Loss tally: everything transpired, respired or sent past the collar, starting from zero.
Each cycle has five moves, always in this order. Finish the whole stem before you start the next move.
Feed. Add the row. Don't check volume yet.
Push, from 1 up to 6. Anything over a segment's volume goes up the xylem into the next segment before you reach it
goes up the xylem into the next segment before you reach it, so one surge can ride the whole stem.
Whatever goes over the top of 6 is transpired.
A QUIET segment at or above its upper mark goes SINK-ACTIVE.
A SINK-ACTIVE segment at or below its lower mark goes QUIET.
Between the marks it stays as it was. Log every flip.
Work out every amount from the sap in place before anything moves.
QUIET respires a quarter. ... Round down both.
SINK-ACTIVE sends half down the phloem to the segment below. ... What segment 1 sends goes to the roots and off our books.
Volume isn't checked here, so a segment can sit overfull until next cycle's push. After cycle 5 it stays that way.
If the stem totals over 38 (exactly 38 doesn't count)
halve every segment, rounding down. What comes off is transpired. ... the cycles in which leaf-drop fired

sap in segments 1 to 6, in order; the state of each segment; every flip as (cycle, segment, before, after); the cycles in which leaf-drop fired; the loss tally; and a balance line: sap at start plus everything fed in, against sap standing plus the tally.
